# Tauber Defence

Tauber Defence is a humorous native iOS tower-defense game by Malaber. Players use non-harmful defenses to reduce pigeons' tolerance until they panic and fly away.

- Product: https://tauber-defence.malaber.de/
- Features: https://tauber-defence.malaber.de/capabilities/
- Support: https://tauber-defence.malaber.de/support/
- Privacy: https://tauber-defence.malaber.de/privacy/
- Source: https://github.com/Malaber/tauber-defence
